citations.assessment: The bare Mesharshya and other sages are addressed by Abaye as their principal teacher. Do not import the separate father claim into this passage.
The lung comparison passage explicitly names Rav Mesharshya as Rava’s son and records the praise.

holds.reason: Retain the explicitly conjectured son attribution. The two named citations do not establish this second-generation relationship.
